test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: Among five friends, Vasudha scored higher marks than Mohan, but lower than Rohan. Jeevan scored higher marks than Deepti, but lower than Mohan. Who among them is the highest scorer?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Vasudha scored higher marks than Mohan, but lower than Rohan.

⇒ Rohan > Vasudha > Mohan 

2) Jeevan scored higher marks than Deepti, but lower than Mohan.

⇒ Mohan > **Jeevan **> Deepti

so, the correct order will be ⇒ Rohan > Vasudha > Mohan > Jeevan > Deepti

So, Rohan is the highest scorer.

Hence, option 4) is the correct answer.
